question: Does this group policy have pre-existing condition exclusions?
expected_answer: No. Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions.
evidence: 8.2 PRE-EXISTING CONDITION LIMITATION: None. Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions.

goal_plan.reasoning: The query asks whether a specific group policy includes exclusions for pre-existing conditions. This is a straightforward factual question about a policy document’s terms. Since the query does not reference any specific group, policy name, or context (e.g., insurance provider, plan type), it cannot be answered without additional information. However, the core task is to determine if such exclusions exist in a given policy. The only way to answer this is to look up the policy’s terms directly. There is no need for multi-hop reasoning because the answer depends solely on the content of the policy itself. The key term is "pre-existing condition exclusions" in the context of a "group policy."

goals: determine if the group policy includes exclusions for pre-existing conditions

candidates.path_text: "Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions." -> Since group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions, individuals can convert their policy at their attained age without being denied due to health history. -> "The conversion policy will be issued at the individual's attained age at conversion." -> The age at which the individual applies for conversion determines the attained age used to issue the new policy. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability."

"Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions." -> Since group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions, individuals can convert their policy at their attained age without being denied due to health history. -> "The conversion policy will be issued at the individual's attained age at conversion." -> Porting coverage after leaving employment allows an individual to convert their group policy to an individual policy based on their attained age at conversion. -> "If an individual leaves employment, they may port their coverage by continuing it as an individual policy."

"Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions." -> Since group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions, individuals can convert their policy at their attained age without being denied due to health history. -> "The conversion policy will be issued at the individual's attained age at conversion." -> The conversion policy is issued at the individual's attained age, which determines the standard premium rates applied. -> "The conversion policy will be issued at standard premium rates for the individual policy."

"Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions." -> The lack of pre-existing condition exclusions enables portability without additional underwriting. -> "If an individual leaves employment, they may port their coverage by continuing it as an individual policy." -> The amount of ported coverage is directly tied to the coverage amount the individual had under the group policy. -> "Ported coverage continues at the same amount the individual had under the group policy."

"Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions." -> The lack of pre-existing condition exclusions enables portability without additional underwriting. -> "If an individual leaves employment, they may port their coverage by continuing it as an individual policy." -> The premium rates for ported coverage are determined by the age-banded group rates applicable to the individual. -> "Premium rates for ported coverage will be age-banded group rates."

"Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions." -> The lack of pre-existing condition exclusions enables portability without additional underwriting. -> "If an individual leaves employment, they may port their coverage by continuing it as an individual policy." -> The ability to port coverage after leaving employment is subject to the maximum conversion limit of $200,000 or the original group coverage amount. -> "The maximum amount for the conversion policy is the lesser of the group coverage amount or $200,000."
